mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( username, password, email, role, display_name, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{role}, #{displayName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = #{username})
SELECT id, username, display_name AS displayName, email, role, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, enabled FROM users ORDER BY id DESC
